description: Source code for testing clock control functionalities in Zephyr RTOS using Litex hardware, including various clock tests such as frequency, duty cycle, and phase adjustments.

methods.name: litex_clk_test_getters
methods.description: Tests retrieval of clock status and rate for multiple clock outputs.

methods.name: litex_clk_test_single
methods.description: Performs a single clock output test with specified frequency, duty, and phase.

methods.name: litex_clk_test_freq
methods.description: Performs frequency sweep tests on clock outputs.

methods.name: litex_clk_test_phase
methods.description: Performs phase adjustment tests on clock outputs.

methods.name: litex_clk_test_duty
methods.description: Performs duty cycle variation tests on clock outputs.

methods.name: litex_clk_test
methods.description: Main function to run selected clock tests based on test type.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes device and runs clock control tests.
